name: Candy Pop
author: Addicting Games
description: Candy Pop is a matching game where you get to match delicious candies! You don’t have to have sweet tooth to play this online game. Just bring your quick clicking skills to match as many candies as you can. This online game has easy controls with cute and bright animation. There are a variety of candies from peppermint, bubble gum, tangerine, and even chocolate! Your objective is to find 2 or more matching candies to click on. The candies must be either next to each other or above each other. Candies cannot be matched diagonally. New candies will fill the top as your matches disappear. At the end of each match, you will get your current score and best score. You will also get a badge to indicate your abilities. Play to challenge yourself beating your best score and earning the gold badge!
